Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Alonzo Contemporary Upholstered Sofa Couch, 80"W, Grey
Colors: Light Grey
Materials: Wood
A single bench cushion brings visual unity and gently sloping armrests give it a sleek, comfortable style. With a solid-wood frame and strong brass legs, this sofa offers durability and elegance. Overall: 80.3"W x 37.8"D x 35.4"H; Seat Height: 18.11"H; Seat Depth: 22"D; Seat Back Height: 17.3"H; Arm Height: 23.6"H; Leg Height: 7.1"H Solid-wood frame with brass metal legs and fabric upholstery. Bench seat cushion with removable back cushions Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
